properties.title: UTM zone 51 — 2017 field boundaries
properties.description: Predicted field boundaries falling in UTM zone 51 for 2017: 4,881,630 parcels, 73,845 km² of field area, in one cloud-native GeoParquet file. Part of [Fields of the World](https://fieldsofthe.world) — agricultural field boundaries delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery. Columns: id, collection, geometry, bbox, metrics:area, metrics:perimeter, score, determination:datetime, determination:method — see `table:columns` for definitions.

table:columns.name: collection
table:columns.description: The vecorel collection the parcel belongs to (constant per year, e.g. `ftw-s2-2025`).

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the parcel (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the parcel in square meters ([vecorel 0.1.0](https://vecorel.org/specification/v0.1.0/schema.yaml) geometry-metrics).

table:columns.name: metrics:perimeter
table:columns.description: Perimeter of the parcel in meters ([vecorel 0.1.0](https://vecorel.org/specification/v0.1.0/schema.yaml) geometry-metrics).

table:columns.name: score
table:columns.description: Mean model field probability inside the parcel, × 100 rounded (0–100).

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The prediction year's UTC start marker, constant per year ([fiboa 0.3.0](https://fiboa.org/specification/v0.3.0/schema.yaml)).
